sentences.cn_text: 波兰数字艺术家格雷格·鲁特科夫斯基运用古典绘画风格创作梦幻般的奇幻景观，曾为《龙与地下城》和《万智牌》等游戏绘制插图。
sentences.en_text: A Polish digital artist who uses classical painting styles to create dreamy fantasy landscapes, Greg Rutkowski has made illustrations for games such as Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering.

sentences.cn_text: 他在文本生成图像的人工智能新领域中迅速走红。
sentences.en_text: And he’s become a sudden hit in the new world of text-to-image AI generation.

sentences.cn_text: 他独特的风格现已成为新开源人工智能艺术生成器Stable Diffusion中最常用的提示词之一。
sentences.en_text: His distinctive style is now one of the most commonly used prompts in the new opensource AI art generator Stable Diffusion.

sentences.cn_text: 该工具与其他流行的图像生成人工智能模型一样，允许任何人根据文本提示创建令人印象深刻的图像。
sentences.en_text: The tool, along with other popular imagegeneration AI models, allows anyone to create impressive images based on text prompts.

sentences.cn_text: 例如，输入「手持长剑和发光魔法火球的巫师与一条凶猛的龙战斗 Greg Rutkowski」，系统将生成与鲁特科夫斯基风格作品相去不远的图像。
sentences.en_text: For example, type in “Wizard with sword and a glowing orb of magic fire fights a fierce dragon Greg Rutkowski,” and the system will produce something that looks not a million miles away from works in Rutkowski’s style.

sentences.cn_text: 但这些开源程序是通过从互联网上抓取图像构建的，往往未经许可，也未对艺术家进行适当署名。
sentences.en_text: But these open-source programs are built by scraping images from the internet, often without permission and proper attribution to artists.

sentences.cn_text: 因此，它们引发了关于伦理和版权的棘手问题。
sentences.en_text: As a result, they are raising tricky questions about ethics and copyright.

sentences.cn_text: 像鲁特科夫斯基这样的艺术家已经受够了。
sentences.en_text: And artists like Rutkowski have had enough.

sentences.cn_text: 据追踪由Stable Diffusion生成的超过1000万张图像和提示词的网站Lexica显示，鲁特科夫斯基的名字被用作提示词约93000次。
sentences.en_text: According to the website Lexica, which tracks over 10 million images and prompts generated by Stable Diffusion, Rutkowski’s name has been used as a prompt around 93,000 times.

sentences.cn_text: 鲁特科夫斯基起初感到惊讶，但认为这可能是接触新受众的好方法。
sentences.en_text: Rutkowski was initially surprised but thought it might be a good way to reach new audiences.

sentences.cn_text: 随后他尝试搜索自己的名字，想看看自己创作的作品是否被发表。
sentences.en_text: Then he tried searching for his name to see if a piece he had worked on had been published.

sentences.cn_text: 在线搜索结果显示，一些附有他名字的作品实际上并非他本人所作。
sentences.en_text: The online search brought back work that had his name attached to it but wasn’t his.

sentences.cn_text: 「这才过去一个月。
sentences.en_text: “It’s been just a month.

sentences.cn_text: 一年后会怎样？
sentences.en_text: What about in a year?

sentences.cn_text: 我可能无法在网上找到自己的作品了，因为互联网将被人工智能艺术淹没，」鲁特科夫斯基说。
sentences.en_text: I probably won’t be able to find my work out there because the internet will be flooded with AI art,” Rutkowski says.

sentences.cn_text: 「这令人担忧。」
sentences.en_text: “That’s concerning.”

sentences.cn_text: 除鲁特科夫斯基外，其他艺术家也对自己作品在文本生成图像工具中的明显流行感到惊讶——一些人现在正在反击。
sentences.en_text: Other artists besides Rutkowski have been surprised by the apparent popularity of their work in text-to-image generators — and some are now fighting back.

sentences.cn_text: 居住在旧金山的插画师卡拉·奥尔蒂斯发现自己的作品出现在Stable Diffusion的数据集中，并一直在提高人们对人工智能艺术和版权问题的认识。
sentences.en_text: Karla Ortiz, an illustrator based in San Francisco who found her work in Stable Diffusion’s data set, has been raising awareness about the issues around AI art and copyright.

sentences.cn_text: 艺术家表示，他们面临收入损失的风险,因为人们开始将基于受版权保护材料生成的人工智能图像用于商业目的。
sentences.en_text: Artists say they risk losing income as people start using AI-generated images based on copyrighted material for commercial purposes.

sentences.cn_text: 但奥尔蒂斯表示，这也更加私人化，她认为由于艺术与个人紧密相关，这可能会引发数据保护和隐私问题。
sentences.en_text: But it’s also a lot more personal, Ortiz says, arguing that because art is so closely linked to a person, it could raise data protection and privacy problems.

sentences.cn_text: 「艺术家行业内正在形成一个联盟，以研究如何应对或缓解这一问题，」奥尔蒂斯说。
sentences.en_text: “There is a coalition growing within artist industries to figure out how to tackle or mitigate this,” says Ortiz.

sentences.cn_text: 该组织正处于动员初期阶段，可能涉及推动新政策或法规的出台。
sentences.en_text: The group is in its early days of mobilization, which could involve pushing for new policies or regulation.

sentences.cn_text: 奥尔蒂斯表示，一种建议是人工智能模型可以使用公共领域的图像进行训练，人工智能公司可以与博物馆和艺术家建立合作关系。
sentences.en_text: One suggestion is that AI models could be trained on images in the public domain, and AI companies could forge partnerships with museums and artists, Ortiz says.

sentences.en_text: What can be learned about Rutkowski from the first two paragraphs?
